title: Evolution Shop Pocket Aquarium Diorama kit (AD-A slice, AD-B creature families, AD-C characters, GR-12 waves 1 to 4, GR-12B body plans)

origin.author: Original local Blender authorship by Claude for Evolution Shop (generated from Tools/Art/create_diorama_kit.py)
origin.license: Original project work; no third-party source or asset license

humanoid_rig.notes: One rig and one builder for every character; roles differ by proportions, outfit, props and colours. Crew wear shop teal; customers never do.

families.Brookkin: river fish: pouty lips, round fins
families.Sparkline: Spark: a glowing lantern on a stalk
families.Cinderling: Ember: a row of glowing ember spines down the back
families.Dewling: Mist: round and pearly, shiny dew beads on the head and back
families.Reefback: Brine: big and gentle reef animals of every kind (GR-12B), crusted with corals that bloom and with barnacles
families.Saltscale: Brine: sleek and shiny, a glittering salt stripe along each side
families.Gloamer: Dusk: deep-sea animals of every kind (GR-12B), each with a glowing lure on a stalk and soft glowing lights
families.Cometail: Spark and Dusk: sea and star animals of every kind (GR-12B), each with a bright glowing head and a comet tail of glowing wisps

body_plans.Keel pivot: a fin under the body that sways with the crest (the sunfish), GR-12B
body_plans.Wave keys: WaveSin, WaveSinNeg, WaveCos, WaveCosNeg on an undulating Body (the oarfish): weighted by the cosine and sine of the swim, a wave from head to tail

export_settings.axis_mapping: Unity (x, y, z) -> Blender (-x, -z, y), a reflection; probed to import exactly
export_settings.hierarchy: every part directly under the asset root and its own pivot; the characters' head parts are reparented onto Head pivot, and the crew's Carry crate onto the parcel socket, in game

unity_import_expected.material_mapping: DK_* slot names map to runtime toon materials

flipbook.drawing: White fills and dark ink outline drawn from wobbled signed-distance shapes, 3x supersampled; particles tint the fill.

variant_atlas.row: species index * 4 + variant index, counted from the top
variant_atlas.sheen: the Sheen column is Shimmer's iridescent rim; its alpha is the strength (0 for the other variants)

validation_limits: Workbench review renders show shape and colour only, not the in-game toon shading, outline or bloom.
In-game scale, fit inside containers and posing are verified by the AD-A, AD-B, AD-C and GR-12 routes, not here.
